name: reboot
description: Build Reboot apps (MCP Apps and standalone Web Apps) from your coding agent. Includes skills for routing, scaffolding, running, and a full Reboot Python reference.

interface.shortDescription: Build MCP Apps and web apps
interface.longDescription: Build, run, inspect and deploy Reboot apps (MCP Apps and standalone web apps) from Codex. Skills route a description to the right kind of app, scaffold it, run it locally, start the developer dashboard, deploy to Reboot Cloud, upgrade Reboot, and give a full Reboot Python reference. On first use the plugin's tools download pinned uv, Node.js, Envoy, cloudflared and portless, and the Reboot CLI from PyPI. The plugin sends no telemetry.
